Hymn 89: The Lord Is My Light
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: James McGranahan
Lyricist/Text Author: James L. Nicholson
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 89 titled "The Lord Is My Light" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by James McGranahan and the lyrics were written by James L. Nicholson.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
